operations.title: Administration
operations.subtitle: Powerful tools to manage and transform your budget data across different years and columns.

cards.freezeDesc: Lock budget columns or headcount metrics for a specific year
cards.copyBudgetDesc: Copy budget data between years and columns with optional percentage adjustments

allocationDefault.title: Default allocation method
allocationDefault.subtitle: Choose how costs are shared across companies by default, for each fiscal year.
allocationDefault.modeManualHelp: The driver is applied to the selected companies only.
allocationDefault.companiesHint: Select at least one company: the selection is saved when the list closes.
allocationDefault.methodHelp: Applies to every OPEX and CAPEX item that uses the default method. Items with an explicit method or a manual allocation are not affected.
allocationDefault.sharesEmpty: No split yet. Select at least one company to see the percentages.
allocationDefault.previewError: The current selection cannot be computed: {{reason}}
allocationDefault.standardNote: Standard method — no override configured for this year.
allocationDefault.overriddenNote: Configured for your organisation. Standard method: {{method}}.
allocationDefault.scopeNote: The method is resolved when allocations are computed: either from the headcount, IT users or turnover of every company enabled for the year, or from the driver value of the companies selected for the default. Changing it re-drives every item left on the default method; manual allocations keep their percentages.
allocationDefault.loadError: Could not load the default allocation method.
allocationDefault.saveError: Could not save the default allocation method.
allocationDefault.noPermission: You need budget administration rights to change the default. The current setting stays visible.

columnReset.title: Reset budget column

copyAllocations.title: Copy allocations
copyAllocations.subtitle: Copy allocation methods and percentages from one year to another, for OPEX or CAPEX.

Copied items keep following the default of their own year — configure {{destinationYear}} in Budget administration if the basis should stay the same.

copyBudgetColumns.title: Copy budget columns
copyBudgetColumns.subtitle: Copy a column to another year or column, for OPEX or CAPEX. Each month keeps its amount, and the percentage applies to every month. Lines that are not valid in the destination year are left out. Lines valid for part of it get only those months.

copyBudgetColumns.copyFailed: The copy failed. Nothing was changed.
copyBudgetColumns.roundingNote: With a percentage, amounts are rounded to whole amounts.
copyBudgetColumns.proratedHelp: This line starts or ends during {{year}}. Only the months within its validity are copied.

copyBudgetColumns.existingDataWarning_other: {{count}} items already have an amount in the destination column and will be skipped. Turn on "Overwrite existing data" to replace them.
